---
title: "Collecting htmls for RegCheck"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-18"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(purrr)

master_list <- read.csv("MASTER_to_code.csv")
```

# Load list of DOIs that were coded

```{r}
master_list <- master_list |>
  filter(exclude != "Excluded") |>
  select(article_number, DOI) |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(!is.na(DOI))

cat("DOIs to pull:", nrow(master_list), "\n")
```

# Load data_key to map DOI -> UID

```{r}
data_key_path <- "../PsycArticles/data_key.xlsx"

data_key <- excel_sheets(data_key_path) |>
  map_dfr(\(s) read_xlsx(data_key_path, sheet = s)) |>
  select(UID, DOI)

uid_keep <- master_list |>
  left_join(data_key, by = "DOI") |>
  filter(!is.na(UID))

cat("Matching UIDs found:", nrow(uid_keep), "\n")
```


# Copy _fulltext.xml files to sample_fulltexts/ 
```{r}
out_dir <- "sample_fulltexts"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

results <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(uid_keep)), function(i) {
  uid            <- uid_keep$UID[i]
  article_number <- uid_keep$article_number[i]

  src <- file.path("../processed_articles", uid, paste0(uid, "_fulltext.xml"))

  if (!file.exists(src)) {
    return(tibble(uid = uid, article_number = article_number, status = "not_found"))
  }

  dest <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(article_number, "_fulltext.xml"))
  file.copy(src, dest, overwrite = TRUE)
  tibble(uid = uid, article_number = article_number, status = "copied")
})
```



# Summary

```{r}
cat("\nDone.\n")
cat("Copied:    ", sum(results$status == "copied"), "\n")
cat("Not found: ", sum(results$status == "not_found"), "\n")

if (any(results$status == "not_found")) {
  cat("UIDs not found in processed_articles:\n")
  cat(paste(" ", results$uid[results$status == "not_found"]), sep = "\n")
}
```
